description: The Study Now, Pay Later Program of the provincial government of Benguet is a local government educational assistance initiative aimed at helping financially constrained but qualified students pursue higher education, especially Doctor of Medicine. Under this program, the province loans financial support (actual tuition fee and book allowance) to selected Benguet-born and resident students so they can study first and repay the loan later. The program was established through the enactment of Provincial Ordinance No. 2017-08 which was revised to update its provisions to align with current circumstances. The latest revision was through Provincial Ordinance No. 2024-339.

This is by virtue of Provincial Ordinance No. 04-92 as amended by the Provincial Ordinance No. 2019-216. Said ordinance stipulates to have on grantee from each of the 140 barangays in the Province of Benguet every year for the college education program; one grantee from each of the 14 Dep-Ed Benguet Districts for the Alternative Learning System (ALS) Program; and four grantees for sports or technical skills program every year.
